notes.title: French, Spanish, Czech, Japanese and Polish version is here!
notes.notes:
While we work on Chapter 2, many players have requested additional languages. Going the extra mile, and with the support of our fans, we have successfully added [b]French, Spanish, Czech, Japanese, and Polish[/b] translations for both the prologue and Chapter 1.

PS
This version includes not just translation but also many bug fixes
and support for other aspect ratio than 16:9 such [b]16:10[/b] and [b]3:2[/b] 🙂

We are aiming to release Chapter 2 in a few months! 🧙🏻‍♂️ 🦝 ❤️ 

Happy new year everyone!
Yakir

notes.title: Version 4.3 - Load-Save and scaling bug fix
notes.notes:
Version 4.3 include the following fixes:
- Saving after finish prologue and then loading - game being stuck with save prompt and state of the game become messed up
- Saving in potion room then loading, in certain case it's making Jase floating  in the room
- Sometimes when characters ending their animation they're changing their scale\direction for one frame (looks like a glitch)

if these bugs stop you from making progress in chapter 1, you can 
restart the chapter from the main menu.
IN THAT CASE - DO NOT USE YOUR OLD SAVE FILES!

notes.title: A new chapter release - November 01!
notes.notes:
Hurray!

A new chapter of Plot of the Druid will be released on 01.11. So save the date!
The game will be released in 'chapter-by-chapter' format, so it will appear in Steam as Early Access. Attaching a NEW cover 🧙‍♂️❤️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36089082/7e19a2f74c82e73ce664d9a7e9876df95add758a.png[/img]

The new chapter will be followed with another 3 chapters as soon as they are ready. Since it can take time, I think it's good to give you a ready-to-play chapter. And for me - getting feedback during the dev, and more funding help going with.

A teaser of the upcoming chapter =>
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Dw5JdC7Bnhw

In the meantime, please wishlist the game and share with friends as much as you can, every wishlist counts!

Cheers!
Yakir

notes.title: Plot of the Druid - Demo Release
notes.notes:
FINALLY, it’s happening! => Plot of the Druid
The FREE DEMO is available now on Steam for PC, Mac and Linux,
with German, Spanish, French and Italian localization.

Hebrew and Russian localization => next month!

The demo is a prologue to the full game – a fantasy point and click adventure with witty British humour inspired by Simon the Sorcerer, Discworld and Harry Potter. (Many LucasArts/Sierra references are also included)

*Important* 
Make sure your screen resolution is set to 1920x1080 before running the demo in order to avoid visual side effects.

Grab a cuppa tea and enjoy!

[previewyoutube=MtZRhKI_mGU;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Estimated release date annoucement!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36089082/5f2d2cfc5a2ed9be5eb9cc78db3bd0500edf2ef3.png[/img]

We’re excited to announce that the estimated release date of “Plot of the Druid” is - [b]Q1 2022[/b]

Plot of the Druid is a story-driven point and click adventure packed with dry, sarcastic British wit
that’s reminiscent of Simon the Sorcerer, Discworld, and Harry Potter. 
The game is filled to the brim with challenging puzzles and a graphical style that uses high-definition hand-painted drawings which also capture the feel of old-school adventure games. Embark on a journey of exploration in a humorous, shameless fantasy world.

Will you be able to attain the incredible power of a master druid? Only one way to find out!

[previewyoutube=dJcjl7Ow9zI;full][/previewyoutube]
